items.description: Disposal of storm debris (roof timber, glass pane, green waste, root ball <1 m3)
items.rationale: All elements are material arising under 5.2.1(a)-(b) (root mass single, under 1 m3), so the combined position passes 7.1.10. Priced from reference: about 60+32+55+40 for the four components.

items.description: Disposal of ground material (soil, topsoil, paving grit)
items.rationale: Ground material is excluded under 4.3(d) and 5.2.1(d); 5.2.2 not met as it is stand-alone clearance with no reinstatement or making good. Not indemnified.
